final_message:
Generated the DNS configuration for all 31 assigned authoritative zones and their 30 delegations. The zone files include the requested service, glue and mail records; `www.example.com` points to pc6.

pc32 (`10.15.8.14`) is configured as the recursive resolver, using pc1 as its root hint. All existing PCs and routers are configured to use it. The topology, IP addresses and existing routes were preserved.

All startup scripts passed a shell syntax check. The lab was not started or validated at runtime; BIND and Kathara validation tools are unavailable in this environment.
